description: The article recommends that art teachers engage students in online research and peer discussion groups as a strategy to raise engagement, attitude, and digital literacy practice.
title: Use online-learning components with peer discussion groups and student choice to increase engagement and attitude toward art

description: The article recommends deploying older students as cross-age tutors, particularly where budgets are constrained.
title: Use older students as tutors in resource-limited settings to enhance academic outcomes

description: The article recommends incorporating real-world sensory cues, specifically disinfectant scent, into VR simulation as a design element to elicit authentic safety behavior.
title: Add real olfactory cues matched to target behaviors when designing VR safety simulations

description: Edyburn recommends that instead of attempting to implement direct instruction at a distance, teachers flip the paradigm: \"project-based learning offers a powerful alternative to promoting student engagement\".
title: Use OLSit-based project-based learning as an alternative to replicating direct instruction remotely
